item.title: Talking Point: What Are You Playing This Weekend? (31st October)

description.p: The spooky weekend is upon us.What's that? You thought the deluge of October news would slow down in its final week? item.title: Digital Foundry Delivers Its Tech Verdict On Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 On Switch 2

description.p: Is it really all that 'Modern'?Just in case the news passed you by, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launched on Switch 2 this month — the first in the series to do so since the Wii U days. Naturally, a lot of the attention has been on the game's performance and whether the Switch 2 would be able to keep up with its competitors. Here to answer exactly that are the tech experts over at Digital Foundry, who have just shared their thoughts on the hybrid version's nitty-gritty details.We'll start with the all-important frame rates. DF states that MW4 runs at 30fps in its campaign mode, 60fps in competitive multiplayer, and 40fps (if you have a 120Hz display hooked up) in the DMZ extraction mode. While this is a little lower than other platforms — particularly in the campaign respect — it does mean that we Switch 2 players can still get the full-fat CoD experience.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Nintendo Cancels Kirby Air Riders Halloween Event Following Performance Woes

description.p: Freeze frame.If you have been keeping up with Kirby Air Riders of late, you might have been excited to dive into the game's new Halloween event this weekend and pick up some spooky Ghost headwear while you're at it. Well, we're sorry, but that's not going to happen, as Nintendo has cancelled the event.The event was originally scheduled to run from 28th October through until 4th November, but many players reported nasty technical difficulties when taking part in early matches, where the screen would regularly freeze — which, in a game as frantic as Air Riders, isn't going to cut it.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Harvest Moon: ﻿Echoes of Teradea Reveals Its Roadmap For 2027, Includes Nine DLC Packs & 30th Anniversary Celebration

description.p: The first DLC is now available.The farming and social sim Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea launched for the Switch 1 & 2 earlier this month, and Natsume has now officially revealed a roadmap for the game that runs through to 2027. item.title: Nintendo Download: 29th October (North America)

description.p: Hello Kitty! Darkest Dungeon! Peak!The latest Nintendo Download update for North America has arrived, and it's bringing new games galore to the eShop. As always, be sure to drop a vote in our poll and comment down below with your potential picks for the week. Enjoy!Switch 2 eShop - HighlightsMinecraft for Nintendo Switch 2 (Mojang, 27th Oct, $29.99) - Survive the night or create a work of art in the iconic sandbox game! Build anything you can imagine, uncover mysteries and face foes in an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough. The Nintendo Switch 2 version features the Vibrant Visuals graphics upgrade, which brings improved visual elements, as well as the Super Mario Mash-Up Pack, where you can explore a custom Mario themed world! The pack also features 15 tracks and 40 player skins inspired by the iconic Super Mario series. description.p: Spewpa Duper.The catchily-titled 'Pokémon Legends: Z-A - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Mega Dimension' releases today, and to mark the occasion, The Pokémon Company has launched a new Mystery Gift distribution in the game.This one is all about Spewpa and its multi-coloured evolution.
